units.title: Images as Numbers
units.blurb: Pixels, colors and the size of a picture in memory.

units.title: From Pixels to Steering
units.blurb: Thresholds, centers and the pinhole camera.

topics.title: Pixels and Image Size
topics.short: An image is a grid of pixels; a color pixel stores three numbers, so a 640 × 480 color frame is 921,600 bytes.
topics.trouble: Students forget the three color channels, or mix up bits and bytes.

topics.title: Color Thresholding
topics.short: Keep the pixels whose color passes a test, such as red − (green + blue)/2 > T; the rest are background.
topics.trouble: Students set one threshold in a bright room and are surprised when it fails in a dim one.

topics.title: Finding the Center and Steering
topics.short: The target's center is the average column of the pixels that pass; the steering error is that minus the image center.
topics.trouble: Students measure the error from the left edge instead of from the center.

topics.title: The Pinhole Camera
topics.short: Image size in pixels = f × real size ÷ distance, so a known size gives the distance.
topics.trouble: Students mix units: focal length in pixels, sizes and distances both in meters.
